title: Filtern nach Kategorie, Tag und Prüfstatus
description: As a developer, I want to combine filters, so that I can narrow down a large registry.

acceptance_criteria.given: the own organisation owns prompts in several categories, tags and scan statuses
acceptance_criteria.when: the developer filters by category Code Gen, tag python and status FLAGGED
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 200 and only prompts matching all three criteria
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-014-filtering.feature: Combined filters narrow the result set

acceptance_criteria.given: a category belongs to another organisation
acceptance_criteria.when: the developer filters by that category id
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 200 and an empty list without any hint that the category exists
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-014-filtering.feature: A foreign category id yields no results

acceptance_criteria.given: the filtered result set spans several pages
acceptance_criteria.when: the developer requests the second page with the same filters
acceptance_criteria.then: the API responds with 200 and returns the next page of the same filtered set
and: the total count matches the filtered set, not the unfiltered one
acceptance_criteria.scenario_ref: US-014-filtering.feature: Pagination stays stable while filters are active
